rows.text: Sent an email from Morgan's address to Priya Raman <priya.raman@fastmail.com> with subject "Re: Offer of help". It read: "Hi Priya, Thank you, that's a generous offer and it fits well with what we're starting. Our first concrete project is a Safety Commitments Tracker. It's a structured, sourced dataset comparing what frontier AI developers have publicly committed to on safety (safety frameworks, eval promises, incident reporting) with what they've actually done, release by release. It's careful data work, and a data analyst's eye would help a lot. What would help most at first, at roughly 5 h/week: 1. Review the draft methodology and column schema. Are the indicators measurable, and is anything ambiguous? 2. Pilot it: fill in rows for one developer, with source and archive links for each cell, so we can see where the definitions break. 3. Later: act as second checker on other people's entries. This is private, early-stage work for now. We're not publishing anything yet. If this sounds good, I'll send you the methodology and schema. Thanks again, Morgan"
rows.quote: Sent a reply to Priya Raman accepting her offer to help. I asked her to review the tracker method and fill in a test set of entries for one developer.
